name: ghostsweep.py
purpose: Image-wide own-pool UND ghost screen: flags any TU whose object leaves an UND lbl_/jumptable_<ADDR> inside that TU's OWN splits.txt range (a latent flip-time link failure invisible to every score-based check). RE-RUN IT, NEVER CITE A PREVIOUS NEGATIVE: `python tools/gdl/ghostsweep.py` (add --json), exit 1 when ghosts exist, ~30s over 257 objects. Requires a built tree. Do NOT substitute a source grep for it (over-reports: MWCC emits many of those symbols as DEFINED, and an unreferenced extern is not a ghost), and do NOT gate a ghost fix on fndiff real (removing a ghost stops our object borrowing the target's placeholder symbol name, so real goes UP while the object gets more correct - claim.law.own-pool-ghost-extern-flatters-fndiff-reloc-rows.20260831.v1); gate on objdump -s -j <pool section> target vs ours plus the unit's data score. CORRECTED 2026-09-01: a pin freezes compiled BODY BYTES not source text — ghosts in pinned bodies CAN be fixed when the respelling reproduces the bytes (btricol 7/7 flip; see claim.law.br-a-pinned-body-freezes-bytes-not-source-text.20260901.v1); audit via the raw .postprocess/body target (frozen source) - screen config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json before editing.
